title: Propane dehydrogenation (PDH) reference family
reaction: C3H8 -> C3H6 + H2 (non-oxidative PDH) | C3H8 + 1/2 O2 -> C3H6 + H2O (oxidative ODHP)
objective: Optional literature-backed family for on-purpose propylene production. Candidates compare a Pt-Sn / Al2O3 commercial benchmark (Oleflex-style), a PtZn intermetallic emerging route, and a boron-nitride oxidative-dehydrogenation (ODHP) route, so the screening can reward either non-oxidative maturity or oxidative selectivity.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported propylene selectivity / stability.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and more reproducible Pt-based PDH preparation routes.

citations.label: Catal. Today 2009
citations.note: Santhosh Kumar, Chen et al.: PDH over Pt-SBA-15 and Pt-Sn-SBA-15 showing how Sn improves Pt dispersion and propylene selectivity, foundational for Pt-Sn PDH design.

citations.label: ChemCatChem 2014
citations.note: Deng, Miura et al.: silica-supported Pt-Sn catalysts prepared by direct reduction; quantifies Sn/Pt ratio effects on stability and selectivity in PDH.

citations.label: Chem. Rev. 2014
citations.note: Sattler, Ruiz-Martinez et al.: foundational review of catalytic dehydrogenation of light alkanes on metals and metal oxides; covers Pt-Sn, Cr-Al2O3, and emerging routes.

citations.label: Science 2016
citations.note: Grant, Carrero et al.: selective oxidative dehydrogenation of propane using boron-nitride catalysts, opening the BN-ODHP route family.

citations.label: J. Catal. 2018
citations.note: Kaylor, Davis et al.: PDH over supported Pt-Sn nanoparticles, mapping how nanoparticle size and Sn coverage tune selectivity / coking trade-offs.

citations.label: Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2020
citations.note: Venegas, Zhang et al.: explanation of why boron nitride is selective for ODHP; identifies surface oxidised B species as the active phase.

citations.label: ACS Catal. 2021
citations.note: Han, Park et al.: PtZn intermetallic compound nanoparticles in mesoporous zeolite exhibiting high catalyst durability for PDH; supports the PtZn intermetallic emerging route.

citations.label: AIChE J. 2021
citations.note: Zhang, Li et al.: PtZn intermetallic nanoalloy encapsulated in silicalite-1 for PDH, establishing zeolite-encapsulated intermetallics for coke resistance.

citations.label: Science 2021
citations.note: Motagamwala, Almallahi et al.: stable and selective catalysts for propane dehydrogenation operating at the thermodynamic limit, demonstrating high-conversion PDH design rules.

citations.label: ChemPlusChem 2022
citations.note: Nakaya, Furukawa et al.: tailoring single-atom platinum for selective and stable catalysts in PDH, surveying the Pt-SA design space for ultra-low Pt loading.

citations.label: Chem. Rev. 2014
citations.note: Canonical light-alkane dehydrogenation review covering the CrOx/Al2O3 Catofin system.

citations.label: Chem. Soc. Rev. 2021
citations.note: Status review of propane and isobutane dehydrogenation over metal-oxide catalysts.

citations.label: Nanomaterials 2017
citations.note: States the Catofin formulation as 18-20 wt% CrOx on gamma-Al2O3 doped with 1-2 wt% K or Na, prepared by aqueous chromium impregnation.

route_templates.name: Pt-Sn / Al2O3 PDH route (Oleflex-style)
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Supported Pt-Sn alumina PDH catalyst preparation
synthesis: Sequential or co-impregnation of Pt and Sn
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable PDH basis and the dominant commercial benchmark (Oleflex-style supported Pt-Sn).

route_templates.name: PtZn intermetallic in zeolite PDH route
synthesis: Pt-Zn precursor introduction into the zeolite
route_templates.route_note: PtZn intermetallic in zeolite route, an emerging high-stability PDH option; zeolite encapsulation discipline reduces route maturity vs Pt-Sn.

route_templates.name: Boron nitride ODHP route
route_templates.route_note: BN-ODHP route is non-oxidative-PDH alternative trading reactor heat duty for an oxidative pathway with high propylene selectivity.

route_templates.name: Chromia impregnation on alumina with shaping
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Tableted fixed-bed catalyst, cyclic Houdry operation
preprocess: Aqueous chromium and alkali solution make-up
postprocess: Indirect calcination to the working chromia phase
route_templates.route_note: Decades-old industrial impregnation chain; no reduction step because the chromia catalyst cycles between oxidized and working states in the Houdry sequence.

candidates.title: Pt-Sn / Al2O3 (Oleflex-style)
candidates.summary: Pt-Sn supported on alumina, the dominant commercial PDH catalyst basis (Oleflex-style); used as the cost and performance anchor.
decision_notes: Most transferable PDH basis and the clearest commercial comparison point.
Catalyst economics dominated by Pt exposure even at low loadings; Sn promoter mitigates coking.

pricing.note: Live Pt feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup for commercial Pt-Sn PDH catalyst screening.
Live Sn feed (LME settlement via Westmetall, USGS MCS fallback) with a precursor / conversion markup; upgraded from the fixed USGS LME-average proxy.

Gamma-alumina support cost held on an engineering proxy comparable to commercial Sasol / BASF alumina ranges. USGS MCS 2026 metallurgical alumina (2025e $590/t import value, ~$0.27/lb) is the public floor; catalyst-grade premium retained. UN Comtrade 2024: calcined alumina (HS 281820) averaged $0.60/kg with specialty flows to $3.64/kg; catalyst-carrier activated/gamma alumina marketplace offers run $800-1,700/t.

candidates.title: PtZn intermetallic / zeolite
candidates.summary: PtZn intermetallic encapsulated in mesoporous zeolite or silicalite-1 for high-stability PDH with reduced coking versus Pt-Sn.
decision_notes: Best fit when long-hold stability and reduced regen cycles matter more than the Pt-Sn maturity.
Zeolite-encapsulation discipline reduces route confidence; intermetallic phase formation needs strict reduction temperature control.

pricing.note: Live Pt feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup.
Live Zn feed (LME settlement via Westmetall, USGS MCS fallback) with a precursor / conversion markup; upgraded from the fixed USGS LME-average proxy.

Mesoporous silicalite-1 support cost held on a derived screening proxy reflecting templated synthesis overhead. UN Comtrade HS 2842.10 synthetic-silicate imports averaged $4.07/kg in 2024; hierarchical MFI carries a templating premium above that floor, so the proxy is retained.

candidates.title: h-BN ODHP route
candidates.summary: Boron-nitride catalyst for oxidative dehydrogenation of propane, providing an alternative non-Pt route with high propylene selectivity.
decision_notes: Use when an oxidative pathway is acceptable and a metal-free catalyst is the program goal.
Combustion / over-oxidation control becomes the main process risk versus the established Pt-Sn route.

pricing.note: Hexagonal boron-nitride catalyst cost held on a derived screening proxy reflecting BN powder grade and surface-conditioning overhead. Public ceiling reference: Sigma 255475 h-BN lab price $2.62/g.

candidates.title: CrOx/Al2O3 (Catofin-type)
candidates.summary: 18-20 wt% chromia on alumina with 1-2 wt% alkali runs the cyclic Catofin dehydrogenation at 540-650 C, trading Pt-free economics for cyclic regeneration and chromium handling constraints.
decision_notes: The Pt-free industrial reference: pick it when metal inventory dominates the decision and cyclic operation is acceptable.
Chromium environmental-handling burden is a real cost outside this screen; noted, not priced.

pricing.evidence_label: UN Comtrade chromium-oxide import unit value
pricing.note: 2024 U.S. imports of HS 281990 (chromium oxides and hydroxides excl. trioxide): $16.45M / 2.91M kg = $5.66/kg CIF.
2025e f.o.b. mine muriate-of-potash price, $600/t of K2O equivalent (USGS MCS Feb 2026).
